name: backupsearch
description: Backup Search Backup Search is the recovery point and item level search for Backup.

subcommands.name: get-search-job
subcommands.description: This operation retrieves metadata of a search job, including its progress.

subcommands.name: get-search-result-export-job
subcommands.description: This operation retrieves the metadata of an export job.

subcommands.name: list-search-job-backups
subcommands.description: This operation returns a list of all backups (recovery points) in a paginated format that were included in the search job.

subcommands.name: list-search-job-results
subcommands.description: This operation returns a list of a specified search job.

subcommands.name: list-search-jobs
subcommands.description: This operation returns a list of search jobs belonging to an account.

subcommands.name: list-search-result-export-jobs
subcommands.description: This operation exports search results of a search job to a specified destination S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: This operation returns the tags for a resource type.

subcommands.name: start-search-job
subcommands.description: This operation creates a search job which returns recovery points filtered by SearchScope and items filtered by ItemFilters.

subcommands.name: start-search-result-export-job
subcommands.description: This operations starts a job to export the results of search job to a designated S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: stop-search-job
subcommands.description: This operations ends a search job.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: This operation puts tags on the resource you indicate.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: This operation removes tags from the specified resource.
